blinding_guess.why: Joint parameters look inconsistent: the UR5 model limits wrist_1_joint to [-pi, 0.25*pi] and wrist_2/wrist_3 to [-pi, pi] in the non-limited description while the UR10 model uses [-2pi, 2pi] everywhere, and the UR10 shoulder_lift_joint has effort 10.0 against 330 for shoulder_pan; either would make consumers of these joint resources (planners, controllers) see wrong limits.

notes: ROS 1 description-only package (catkin, no nodes, no msg/srv/action). All nine packet elements are URDF links/joints declared inside the xacro macros ur5_robot (urdf/ur5.urdf.xacro, urdf/ur5_joint_limited.urdf.xacro) and ur10_robot (urdf/ur10.urdf.xacro, urdf/ur10_joint_limited.urdf.xacro), named with a ${prefix} parameter; the four *_robot.urdf.xacro files instantiate them with prefix="" and launch/ur5_upload.launch / ur10_upload.launch load the xacro output into param robot_description (a provided param outside the packet). The four pre-generated urdf/*_robot.urdf files hard-code the same names without prefix (e.g. ur5_robot.urdf:36 <link name="base_link">). declares uses the api template because no frame/joint template exists; symbol is the identifier verbatim including ${prefix}; the declaration line is identical (after whitespace collapse) in all four macro files, cited from ur5.urdf.xacro (ur10.urdf.xacro lines 53,269,263,137,105,75,167,199,231). Joint ports have frame null: a URDF joint declares a parent and a child link rather than a data frame (shoulder_pan: base_link->shoulder_link; shoulder_lift: shoulder_link->upper_arm_link; elbow: upper_arm_link->forearm_link; wrist_1: forearm_link->wrist_1_link; wrist_2: wrist_1_link->wrist_2_link; wrist_3: wrist_2_link->wrist_3_link; ee_fixed_joint (type fixed): wrist_3_link->ee_link, origin xyz 0 ${wrist_3_length} 0 rpy 0 0 ${pi/2.0}). units rad for the six revolute joints because limits and velocities are written as multiples of the xacro property pi (URDF/REP-103 radians); ee_fixed_joint has no joint variable, units null; frame ports units null (no unit stated). QoS null (ROS 1); msg_type and definition_id null (no message carries these elements in this package). Declared limits: UR5 shoulder_pan/shoulder_lift/elbow [-2pi,2pi] effort 150, wrist_1 [-pi,0.25pi] effort 28, wrist_2/wrist_3 [-pi,pi] effort 28; UR10 all six [-2pi,2pi], efforts pan 330 (velocity 2.16), shoulder_lift 10.0, elbow 150, wrists 54; joint_limited variants set [-pi,pi] on UR5 pan/lift/elbow and on all six UR10 joints. exclusive is empty: urdf/ur5.transmission.xacro and ur10.transmission.xacro declare transmission_interface/SimpleTransmission with hardwareInterface EffortJointInterface and actuators ${prefix}<joint>_motor for the six revolute joints, exposing them to ros_control (gazebo.urdf.xacro loads libgazebo_ros_control.so), but the package itself claims no resource. Other observations: ur10.gazebo.xacro references links ${prefix}shoulder_pan_link, ${prefix}shoulder_lift_link and ${prefix}elbow_link that are not declared anywhere (declared names are shoulder_link, upper_arm_link, forearm_link); ur5.gazebo.xacro references a link named universal_robot that is not declared. launch/test.launch starts joint_state_publisher, robot_state_publisher (type state_publisher) and rviz with $(find urdf_tutorial)/urdf.rviz; these executables/files are not recorded as references. package.xml run_depends only on urdf although the launch files call $(find xacro)/xacro.py. No packet element is consumed by this package.
